items.title: Weather page: search or enter location (city text or lat/lon) and load forecast
items.traces_goal: location lookup on the weather page improves the public weather experience

definition_of_done: /weather includes a clear control (search field and/or structured lat/lon) to choose location; requests /api/weather (or equivalent) with that input.
Loading and success states are obvious; design-system tokens only; no hardcoded hex.
User-visible behavior is gated with lib/feature-flags.ts + an FF_* env unless the implementing prompt waives flags.
pnpm verify passes.

items.title: Weather: visible error and retry-friendly state when the API fails or returns an error
items.traces_goal: dependable error feedback for the weather experience

definition_of_done: When /api/weather fails or returns an error field, /weather shows a clear message (and optional retry) using DS tokens.
No silent blank screen on failure.
User-visible behavior is gated with lib/feature-flags.ts + an FF_* env unless the implementing prompt waives flags.
pnpm verify passes.

items.title: Calculator: clearer layout, spacing, and control grouping on /calculator
items.traces_goal: clearer calculator layout improves the public calculator experience

definition_of_done: /calculator is easier to scan: grouped keys, readable display, consistent spacing using existing DS patterns.
No change to frozen layout shell files unless a human prompt permits; prefer calculator route components.
User-visible behavior is gated with lib/feature-flags.ts + an FF_* env unless the implementing prompt waives flags.
pnpm verify passes.

items.title: Calculator: keyboard entry and visible focus for controls
items.traces_goal: keyboard accessibility for the calculator experience

definition_of_done: Digits and primary operations usable via keyboard where reasonable; focus states visible (token-based).
Matches repo a11y conventions; no new arbitrary colors.
User-visible behavior is gated with lib/feature-flags.ts + an FF_* env unless the implementing prompt waives flags.
pnpm verify passes.

items.title: Weather API: optional location query params with safe defaults (Open-Meteo or current provider)
items.traces_goal: API query flexibility for weather supports location lookup

definition_of_done: Route handler accepts optional location-derived query parameters with documented defaults; no secrets in client bundle.
Behavior remains safe when params are omitted (sensible default location).
User-visible behavior is gated with lib/feature-flags.ts + an FF_* env unless the implementing prompt waives flags.
pnpm verify passes.

items.title: Calculator: route metadata (title and description) for /calculator
items.traces_goal: route metadata improves discoverability and polish for the calculator

definition_of_done: app/calculator has appropriate metadata (title/description) via App Router patterns; tokens only for any styled preview if applicable.
pnpm verify passes.

items.title: Navbar: Calculator and Weather links remain obvious on desktop and mobile
items.traces_goal: navbar discoverability for Calculator and Weather

definition_of_done: Desktop and mobile nav include labeled Calculator and Weather links to /calculator and /weather using Navbar + config/navigation patterns.
User-visible behavior is gated with lib/feature-flags.ts + an FF_* env unless the implementing prompt waives flags.
pnpm verify passes.
